evidence_timeline.summary: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS23pse (AT2023nzt) in galaxy NGC 0925 at magnitude m_c = 19.15 +/- 0.16. At a distance of 9 Mpc (redshift independent, from NED), the transient (possibly an LRN or LBV) was discovered on MJD = 60147.56 (2023-07-22.56) with an absolute magnitude of M = -10.7 +/- 0.2. The last non-detection through forced photometry was on MJD = 60139.62. Forced photometry indicates that the transient is slowly rising (with an initial peak on the discovery date). Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.
